title: The Book by the Pond
lines: Gus took a good book to the pond.
Mom sat with him on the soft grass.
Gus stood on a wood log to see the pond.
A duck came to look at his book.
Mom held Gus as the wet log shook.
His good book fell in the pond!
Gus got a thin stick from the grass.
The stick was short and did not reach.
Then Gus took a hook from his bag.
He tied the hook on to the thin stick.
Gus stood with Mom and got the book back.
It was wet, so he took it home.

questions.ask: Where did Gus stand to see the pond?
questions.listenFor: On a wood log, by the pond. Have them point to that line.

questions.ask: Why did the thin stick not work at first?
questions.listenFor: It was short and did not reach. So Gus tied a hook on to it.

questions.ask: The story says the wet log shook. What does shook mean? Show me with your hands.
questions.listenFor: Moved and wobbled. Line five. Acting it out is the check that they really have the word.
